_doc: Project-level material registry. Built during material collection phase, reused by all subsequent nodes. Stored at .worktree/material-registry.json. Keys must be unique paths relative to session root (never absolute).

history/2024-bid/技术方案.docx.quality: 结构可复用，参数需更新
history/2024-bid/技术方案.docx.caveats: 公司名为旧名称'XX科技'，需替换为当前公司名

合作方A/营业执照.pdf.caveats: 与根目录同名文件不是同一主体，必须按 rel_path 区分

field_definitions.key: Session-root relative path, globally unique inside this session (example: 合作方A/营业执照.pdf)
field_definitions.type: Material type: 招标文件 | 招标附件 | 产品数据手册 | 历史标书 | 资质文件 | 方案文档 | 报价参考 | 其他
field_definitions.format: File format: pdf | docx | xlsx | pptx | doc | image
field_definitions.covers: List of content topics this material covers
field_definitions.useful_for_reqs: List of requirement IDs this material can serve. Supports wildcards (e.g. req-5.1.*)
field_definitions.quality: Quality assessment: official doc / internal doc / credibility note
field_definitions.caveats: Usage notes (e.g. company name needs replacement, params outdated). null if none
